paper.title_en: Exact holographic superfluid at the Bogomolny point: transport, large charge, and Rényi entropies
paper.abstract_en: The Abelian Higgs model in AdS$_5$, in the probe limit, is a standard holographic model of a strongly coupled superfluid, usually solved numerically. When the scalar mass saturates the Breitenlohner-Freedman bound and the quartic coupling takes the Bogomolny value, its condensed phase can be found in closed form on every static, uncharged AdS$_5$ background with maximally symmetric spatial sections. We prove that it is linearly stable, as is any nodeless probe-limit condensate in the standard quantization with a nonnegative quartic coupling and no superflow. On each slicing it answers a different question about the dual conformal field theory. On the planar black brane it is the superfluid at all temperatures below $T_c$: the superfluid fraction follows the Gorter-Casimir two-fluid law exactly, and the speed and the attenuation of sound are found in closed form. In global AdS$_5$ it describes a state of charge $Q$ on $\mathbb{R}\times S^3$, arguably the lowest-energy one, and gives its scaling dimension in closed form at all $Q$, classically in the bulk. Its excitations include towers that the superfluid effective theory does not describe; they come from an infrared fixed point of the probe sector. The hyperbolic slicing gives in closed form a homogeneous hairy phase of the black holes that compute the charged Rényi entropies of a ball. Its condensate does not vanish at the entangling surface. When sourced by operators inserted there, the phase sets in at Rényi index exactly one at zero chemical potential, as found for a neutral scalar.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在Bogomolny点给出AdS₅中Abelian Higgs模型凝聚相的闭式解，并系统讨论平面、整体及双曲切片下对应的超流输运、大电荷态标度维数与Rényi熵，理论深度与新意较高，值得点击进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: Bogomolny点的精确全息超流体：输运、大电荷与Rényi熵
decision.abstract_zh: AdS$_5$中探针极限下的Abelian Higgs模型是强耦合超流体的标准全息模型，通常用数值方法求解。当标量质量饱和Breitenlohner-Freedman界且四次耦合取Bogomolny值时，其凝聚相可在每一个具有极大对称空间截面的静态、不带电AdS$_5$背景上以闭式形式求得。我们证明它是线性稳定的，正如在标准量子化下、四次耦合非负且无超流时任何无节点的探针极限凝聚态一样。在每一种切片上，它回答关于对偶共形场论的一个不同问题。在平面黑膜上，它就是所有温度低于$T_c$时的超流体：超流组分精确遵循Gorter-Casimir双流体定律，声速与声衰减均以闭式形式给出。在整体AdS$_5$中，它描述$\mathbb{R}\times S^3$上电荷为$Q$的一个态，可以说是能量最低的态，并在所有$Q$下以闭式形式给出其标度维数，在体中是经典结果。其激发包括超流体有效理论未描述的塔，它们来自探针部分的一个红外不动点。双曲切片以闭式形式给出计算球带电Rényi熵的黑洞的一个均匀带毛相。其凝聚在纠缠面上不为零。当由插入该处的算符作为源时，该相在零化学势下恰好在Rényi指数为一时出现，与中性标量的结果相同。
